content:
{
  "done": false,
  "tool": "manage_backends",
  "args": {
    "name": "Rates Watch Data",
    "url": "http://localhost:7803",
    "operation": "add",
    "widgets_json": {
      "curve_spread_metric": {
        "name": "2s10s Spread",
        "description": "Current 2s10s spread in bps.",
        "endpoint": "/curve-spread",
        "type": "metric",
        "w": 6,
        "h": 4,
        "category": "Macro",
        "staleTime": 900000,
        "refetchInterval": 30000,
        "params": [
          {
            "paramName": "curve_view",
            "type": "text",
            "label": "Curve View",
            "value": "2s10s",
            "description": "Curve segment in focus."
          }
        ]
      },
      "rates_commentary": {
        "name": "Rates Commentary",
        "description": "Desk commentary on the rates day.",
        "endpoint": "/rates-commentary",
        "type": "markdown",
        "w": 12,
        "h": 8,
        "category": "Macro",
        "staleTime": 900000,
        "refetchInterval": 30000,
        "params": [
          {
            "paramName": "series",
            "type": "endpoint",
            "label": "Series",
            "optionsEndpoint": "/series-options",
            "value": "DGS10"
          }
        ]
      },
      "yield_curve": {
        "name": "Yield Curve",
        "description": "Plotly treasury yield curve snapshot.",
        "endpoint": "/yield-curve",
        "type": "chart",
        "w": 20,
        "h": 9,
        "category": "Macro",
        "staleTime": 900000,
        "raw": true,
        "refetchInterval": 30000
      }
    }
  }
}

rates_commentary.name: Rates Commentary
rates_commentary.description: Desk commentary on the rates day.
